title: The Howling Pass
text: The wind in the pass howls names. Old names, House names, the names of the dead, flung against the rock and thrown back. And now and then, faint but clear, one of yours, in a voice you know.

options.label: Shout your names back into it.

outcomes.text: The wind takes them and goes quiet, satisfied.

options.label: The wisest listens for one name in particular.

outcomes.text: A name from the founding of your Houses, and what became of it.

options.label: Stop your ears and hurry through.

outcomes.text: It howls at your backs all the way down.
